newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Shi'ite party leader in Pakistani city.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Shi'ite party leader in Pakistani city.

text.p: Two gunmen on a motorcycle killed a local leader of a Shi'ite Moslem group in the Pakistani city of Lahore on Monday, police said.
They said Talib Hussain Karnalvi was killed while he was walking along a street at about 8:00 a.m. (0300 GMT) in a southern district of the Punjab provincial capital.
Police said Karnalvi was the chairman of the local branch of a Shi'ite religious organisation but did not give its name.
More than 110 people have been killed this year in a long-running feud between militant Sunni and Shi'ite Moslem groups in Pakistan.
Police rounded up scores of religious activists in Punjab province last week in an effort to curb sectarian violence.
